newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Quinenco sets IPO price 750 pesos.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Quinenco sets IPO price 750 pesos.

text.p: Chilean holding company Quinenco has set a minimum price of 750.96 pesos per share for its initial public offering Wednesday in local and international markets, said the Santiago Commercial Stock Exchange.
The company will sell 28.9 million shares in Santiago in an auction at 0915 local (1415 GMT) and expects to raise $52 million from the sale, said the statement.
Quinenco is the holding company for the Luksic industrial group which has investments in the brewing, manufacturing and telecommunications industries.
